shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure occupying most of the field
garment or drapery indicated by incised lines
headgear or cap on the figure's head
justification: Both are stone works dominated by a single anthropomorphic figure with a distinctive headpiece, an emphasized arm, and circular disc/rosette motifs, and both use incised linear detail to indicate garments. But A is a heavily eroded, frontal, three-dimensional block-like figure with broad low-relief masses on a rounded body, while B is a flat rectangular slab bearing a crisply cut profile figure with elaborately combed wings, beard and plant forms — the rendering, viewpoint and level of detail have almost nothing in common.
